audit_scope: read-only telemetry and Unity Editor.log review; no model replay, training, or service startup

method.log_join: Exact run_id match on one [ExperimentalModelWarning] record per line.
method.active_segment_rule: First ACTIVE opens a contiguous logged active segment; following ACTIVE rows extend it; first REVOKED closes it.
method.preceding_received_rule: For each ACTIVE/REVOKED segment retain nearest earlier RECEIVED log row, including reason and revoke_reason raw status.
method.time_domains: Editor local_monotonic_s is only compared with itself. CSV backend/source timestamps are epoch/UTC telemetry clocks and are not subtracted from monotonic log times.
method.csv_motion_join: The logged prediction sequence is not mapped to a CSV movement instant; these logs do not expose a reliable input sequence join.
method.geometry_rule: Unity telemetry directional_edge_distance minus ball_radius; rows are ordered by file position within Unity source.
method.timestamp_gap_rule: Flag adjacent Unity geometry_source_timestamp jumps > 0.100 s; geometry version changes are reported separately.

active_episodes.timeout_interpretation: frontend age expiry observed; not evidence of backend stop time
